function.description: Fetches the weather prediction for a specified location and date range, including temperature, precipitation chances, and wind speed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographical location for which the weather forecast is requested, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'London, UK'.

start_date.description: The start date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

end_date.description: The end date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

units.description: The unit system used for the weather forecast results.

include_details.description: A flag indicating whether to include detailed forecast information such as hourly data.

### The “Best” Men’s Underwear Styles – A Quick Guide When it comes to men’s underwear, “best” is a mix of comfort, fit, durability, and style. Below is a rundown of the most popular styles, what they’re best for, and key features to look for when shopping. | Style | Description | Ideal For | Key Features | |-------|-------------|-----------|--------------| | **Boxer Briefs** | Combines the length of boxers with the snugness of briefs. | Everyday wear, gym, travel. | • Full‑leg coverage
• Good support
• Breathable fabrics (cotton, modal, bamboo)
• Seamless or flat‑lock seams | | **Briefs (Classic)** | Short‑leg, snug fit that sits just above the hips. | Work, casual, sports. | • Tight fit for support
• Minimal fabric at the back
• Often made from cotton or microfiber | | **Trunks** | Shorter than boxer briefs, longer than briefs. | Fashion‑forward, active wear. | • Mid‑thigh length
• Sleek silhouette
• Usually cotton or performance blends | | **Boxers** | Loose, long‑leg, relaxed fit. | Sleep, lounging, casual. | • Maximum airflow
• Soft cotton or linen
• No support (great for comfort) | | **Compression Briefs** | Tight, supportive, often with a higher waistband. | Athletic performance, recovery. | • Muscle support
• Moisture‑wicking
• Usually polyester or nylon blends | | **Bamboo/Modal** | Made from bamboo pulp or modal fibers. | Eco‑friendly, sensitive skin. | • Ultra‑soft, breathable
• Natural antibacterial properties
• Good moisture management | | **Performance/Tech** | Designed for high‑activity use. | Sports, hiking, travel. | • Moisture‑wicking
• Anti‑odor treatment
• Stretch fabrics | | **Luxury/Designer** | Premium fabrics, designer cuts. | Special occasions, gifting. | • Cashmere, silk blends
• Fine stitching
• Unique patterns or logos | --- ## How to Choose the Right Style 1. **Consider Your Daily Activities** - **Active Lifestyle**: Compression briefs or performance boxer briefs. - **Office/Work**: Classic briefs or boxer briefs for support and modesty. - **Relaxation**: Boxers or loose‑fit briefs for maximum comfort. 2. **Fabric Matters** - **Cotton**: Breathable, natural, but can retain moisture. - **Microfiber/Polyester**: Lightweight, dries quickly, good for sweat. - **Bamboo/Modal**: Soft, eco‑friendly, excellent moisture control. - **Silk/Cashmere**: Luxurious feel, great for special occasions. 3. **Fit & Support** - **Waistband**: Look for a wide, elastic waistband that doesn’t dig into the skin. - **Seam Placement**: Flat‑lock seams reduce friction and irritation. - **Length**: Boxer briefs offer full coverage; trunks are shorter and more fashion‑oriented. 4. **Maintenance** - **Washability**: Most performance fabrics are machine washable. - **Durability**: Check for reinforced stitching at stress points (e.g., waistband, crotch). 5. **Budget** - **Economical**: Basic cotton briefs or boxers. - **Mid‑Range**: Performance blends or bamboo. - **Premium**: Designer labels, luxury fabrics. --- ## Quick Recommendations | Need | Best Pick | |------|-----------| | **All‑day comfort** | Boxer briefs in 100% cotton or bamboo. | | **Gym & sports** | Compression briefs or performance boxer briefs. | | **Travel** | Seamless briefs or compression briefs (no bulk). | | **Sensitive skin** | Bamboo or modal briefs. | | **Eco‑friendly** | Bamboo or modal, or recycled polyester blends. | | **Luxury** | Silk‑blend briefs or cashmere‑infused boxer briefs. | --- ### Final Thought The “best” underwear is ultimately the one that feels right for you—supportive enough for your day, breathable for your skin, and stylish enough to match your personality. Try a few different styles and fabrics to find your perfect match. Happy shopping!
